mentions.name: mib
mentions.description: A minimal GUI Markdown scratchpad app for Linux/Wayland designed for throwaway notes. Built as an exploration of how small a GUI app can be, it comes in under 300 KiB with extremely fast startup, and the code is open for others (or their agents) to shrink further.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wanted to explore what is possible in terms of making a very minimal GUI app on Linux / Wayland. It's a Markdown scratchpad thing for throwaway notes https://github.com/osigurdson/mib.

I was able to get it down to under 300KiB and I absolutely love how fast it starts (incandescent light-bulb fast).
